messages.subject: problem with qplot and color
parts:
Hello

When I run

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1410)
dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100),]
qplot(carat, price, data = dsmall, color = dsmall$color)

there are no colors on the plot.

If I run it without the dsmall$ then "color is not found"

The code is straight from the book, p 12


Peter
